name: Jesus Parables
overview: Jesus used parables to reveal profound spiritual truths about the kingdom of heaven and the believer's life. For example, He compared the kingdom to leaven that permeates and transforms, illustrating the subtle yet powerful growth of God's reign (Matthew 13:33). He also emphasized the importance of preserving spiritual vitality and peace among believers, likening them to salt that must retain its flavor (Mark 9:50). Through parables like the rich man’s story, Jesus warns of the eternal consequences tied to earthly living (Luke 16:19), while His declarations as the Good Shepherd who lays down His life (John 10:11) and the Son given for everlasting life (John 3:16) center the message firmly on Christ’s sacrificial love and redemptive mission.
